P15 global-sensitivity-and-robustness.presentation: Saltelli and Annoni 2010: the common source-presentation notation. The input law and domain govern the chapter; the other rows retain their declared roles throughout this presentation. Baseline b, regression b, the variance index set, and source-example variables have separate local bindings below.

P15 global-sensitivity-and-robustness OA.presentation: Saltelli and Annoni 2010: the baseline b in the model and one-at-a-time sections and their two proofs.

P15 global-sensitivity-and-robustness va.presentation: Saltelli and Annoni 2010: the finite factor-index set I in the independent-input variance treatment and its calculations.

P15 global-sensitivity-and-robustness so.presentation: Saltelli and Annoni 2010: source toy functions, their moments, and the rate-chain application. The rate row still needs a truthful local first-use anchor; see required_field_corrections.

P15 global-sensitivity-and-robustness ca.presentation: The explicit observational/interventional counterexample associated with the sensitivity treatment.

P18 refutation diagnosis quantity exampl.presentation: Initial and retained possession sets in the named two-case example.

P18 refutation diagnosis ownership examp.presentation: Local ownership and parenthood relations and their named objects.

P18 refutation diagnosis qualification e.presentation: Context-relative evaluation and the arithmetic double-of relation in the named qualification example.

P15 factorial inference.presentation: NIST/SEMATECH factorial treatment: the analysis matrix X, coefficient vector beta, and mean-zero error vector epsilon retain their linear-model roles throughout the chapter and annex.

P15 factorial estimability.presentation: Coefficient-space contrast weights and observation-space estimator weights in the row-space criterion. Later local uses may be added only where those same roles have exact boundaries.

P15 factorial two-by-two.presentation: The four-cell means, conditional differences, interaction contrast, and saturated H2 analysis matrix.

P15 factorial uncertainty.presentation: Least-squares uncertainty, the joint nested-model test, and residual/pure-error distinctions in the uncertainty section.

P15 factorial replication.presentation: Within-setting pure error and unit/repeated-measurement components in the replication theorem and proof.

P15 factorial blocking.presentation: Centered treatment and block effects in the additive randomized complete-block model.

P15 factorial square designs.presentation: The level count s, total factor count k, and centered level effects in orthogonal square designs.

P15 factorial full and fractional design.presentation: Product columns chi_S through the contiguous full-design, execution, regular-fraction, half-fraction, and eight-run treatments.

P15 factorial word notation.presentation: The all-ones column or empty word I in the full-design table and fraction-word treatment. The execution section with block I/II is excluded.

P15 factorial fractions.presentation: Defining word groups, their signs, and symmetric difference in the regular-fraction treatment and its alias/resolution proofs.

P15 factorial causal interpretation.presentation: Finite assignment probabilities, potential responses, treatment assignments, and inverse-probability contrast estimation.
